Short: NG HIV Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register
Definition:
Logical model for the patient-level Nigeria Enhanced Adherence Counselling
Monitoring Register. One model instance represents one facility monthly cohort
page and contains repeatable client entries corresponding to printed columns
A1 through A24.
Identifier assigned to the monthly EAC register page or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the facility maintaining the EAC register, when available.
Official name of the facility providing Enhanced Adherence Counselling services.
Local Government Area where the facility is located.
State where the facility is located.
Monthly cohort period. The month should correspond to the month the qualifying viral-load result was received at the facility.
One patient-level row of the Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register.

Definition: Reference to the corresponding Nigeria Core Patient resource, when available.
Sequential number assigned to the client within the monthly register page.
Facility hospital or unit number assigned to the client.
National HIV program ART unique identifier.
Client full name, recorded surname first followed by other names.
Client sex represented by the printed male or female columns.
Client age at registration into the EAC monthly cohort.
Age in years, or months when the client is younger than one year.
Constraint(s): A7 age unit implied by SOP

Definition: Date the client commenced antiretroviral therapy.
Register ART regimen code at enrolment into EAC.

Short: A9 Current ART regimen source text
Definition: Regimen description retained when the source does not provide a valid register code.
Most recent viral-load result prompting EAC registration, in copies/mL. The register is intended for results greater than 50 copies/mL.
Date the qualifying viral-load result was received at the facility. This date determines the monthly cohort.
True when index testing was offered; false when it was not offered.
Enhanced Adherence Counselling session delivered to the client.

Definition: EAC session sequence. EAC-1, EAC-2 and EAC-3 map to A13–A15; later sessions map to A16.
Constraint(s): A13 first EAC / A14 second EAC / A15 third EAC / A16 additional EAC

Definition: Date the EAC session was delivered.

Short: A17 Date post-EAC VL sample collected
Definition: Date the post-EAC viral-load sample was collected after the counselling sequence.
Post-EAC repeat viral-load result in copies/mL.
Date the post-EAC viral-load result was received at the facility.

Short: A19 Suspected cause of virologic failure
Definition: One or more suspected causes selected from the codes printed on the register.
Narrative description when code 3, other suspected cause, is selected.
True when the ART regimen was switched following EAC; false when it was not switched.
Date the regimen switch occurred when regimenSwitched is true.
Register ART regimen code after switch or substitution.

Short: A22 New ART regimen source text
Definition: Regimen description retained when a valid register code is unavailable.

Short: A23 Repeat viral-load result one year later
Definition: Viral-load result obtained approximately one year after EAC and any regimen switch, in copies/mL.

Short: A23 Date one-year repeat result received
Definition: Date the one-year repeat viral-load result was received at the facility.
Additional notes on EAC completion or stoppage, missed sessions, result delays, regimen changes, follow-up outcomes or further action plans.
